Grimm Meisaku Gekijou Vol. 2 - Hansel to.summary: The game relies heavily on the then new full motion video feature of the 3DO. The game is a compilation of cartoons, all loosely based upon stories made famous by the Brothers Grimm. The animation for the cartoons was done by the famous Nippon Anime Corporation.
